payment_terms.value_text: Payment shall be made no later than 30 days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement for an interim payment certificate, or from the date of submission of the Final Payment Certificate.
payment_terms.quote: payment shall be made no later than 30 (thirty) days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement by the Contractor to the Authority’s Engineer for certification in accordance with the provisions of Clause 19.4 for an IPC
payment_terms.notes: There is also a provision for part payment of 90% of the determined amount within 10 days of the receipt of recommendation of the Authority's Engineer as per Clause 19.5(i), but the main payment term for an IPC is 30 days under Clause 19.9.

retention.value_text: The Authority shall deduct 6% from every payment for Works as Retention Money, subject to a maximum cap of 5% of the Contract Price.
retention.quote: From every payment for Works due to the Contractor in accordance with the provisions of Clause 19.5, the Authority shall deduct 6% (six per cent) thereof as guarantee money for performance of the obligations of the Contractor during the Construction Period (the “Retention Money”) subject to the condition that the maximum amount of Retention Money shall not exceed 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price.
retention.notes: The per-bill deduction is 6%, but clause 7.5(i) caps the maximum total retention at 5% of the Contract Price.

advance.value_text: An interest-bearing advance payment equal to 10% of the Contract Price for mobilisation expenses, made in two instalments of 5% each.
advance.quote: The Authority shall make an interest-bearing advance payment (the “Advance Payment”) @ “Bank Rate + 3%”, equal to 10 % (ten percent) of the Contract Price, exclusively for mobilisation expenses. The Advance Payment for mobilisation expenses shall be made in two instalments each equal to 5% (five percent) of the Contract Price.
advance.notes: The advance is interest-bearing at 'Bank Rate + 3%', compounded annually on a reducing balance basis. Additionally, an equipment advance of up to 5% of the Contract Price against Bank Guarantee is available.

liquidated_damages.value_text: The contractor must pay damages of 0.05% of the Contract Price for each day of delay in achieving any Project Milestone or the Scheduled Completion Date.
liquidated_damages.unit: % per day of the Contract Price
liquidated_damages.quote: In the event that the Contractor fails to achieve any Project Milestone or the Scheduled Completion Date within a period of 30 (thirty) days from the date set forth in Schedule-J, unless such failure has occurred due to Force Majeure or for reasons solely attributable to the Authority, it shall pay Damages to the Authority of a sum calculated at the rate of 0.05% (zero point zero five percent) of the Contract Price for delay of each day reckoned from the date specified in Schedule –J and until such Project Milestone is achieved or the Project Highway is completed
liquidated_damages.notes: Excerpt page 89 also mentions maintenance delay damages (0.1% of monthly maintenance payment), but the primary contractor construction delay penalty is 0.05% per day of the Contract Price.

escalation.value_text: The amounts payable to the Contractor for Works and Maintenance shall be adjusted for changes in rates and prices of inputs in accordance with the prescribed formulae.
escalation.quote:
19.10  Price adjustment for the Works
(i)
The amounts payable to the Contractor for Works shall be adjusted in accordance
with the provisions of this Clause 19.10
escalation.notes: Price adjustment applies to both Works (Clause 19.10) and Maintenance of Project Highway (Clause 19.12) using specific input component percentages and indices.

performance_security.value_text: The contractor must furnish an irrevocable and unconditional bank guarantee for the Performance Security equal to 3% of the Bid Price, valid until 60 days after the Defects Liability Period.
performance_security.quote: Within 30 (thirty) days of receipt of Letter of Acceptance, the selected Bidder shall furnish to the Authority an irrevocable and unconditional guarantee from a Bank in the form set forth in Annex-I of Schedule-G (the “Performance Security”) for an amount equal to 3% (Three percent) of its Bid Price.
performance_security.notes: An Additional Performance Security may also be required under certain bidding conditions. Option is available to provide 50% within 30 days of LOA/before signing contract, and the remaining 50% within 30 days of signing the agreement.
